insight.headline: Multiple Tracking Numbers
insight.what_changed: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment. A new field called `trackingNumbers` has been added to `OrderCreateFulfillmentInput`. This allows developers to attach multiple tracking numbers to a fulfillment when importing orders. The change is backward compatible and does not require any immediate action.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the `orderCreate` mutation should be aware of this change and can start using the new `trackingNumbers` field to provide more detailed tracking information for fulfillments. This can enhance the merchant's ability to track orders and provide better customer service. No migration is required, but developers can choose to update their code to utilize the new field for enhanced functionality.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will benefit from more accurate and detailed tracking information for their orders, potentially leading to improved customer satisfaction and reduced support queries.
insight.why_it_matters: This change matters because it provides more flexibility and accuracy in tracking orders, which is crucial for both merchants and customers. It enhances the overall Shopify experience by allowing for better order management and customer communication.

themes.title: Hydrogen Updates
themes.detail: Hydrogen developer preview update adds new capabilities, including Vue bindings, and Oxygen is now available on development stores. The @shopify/cli-hydrogen and @shopify/mini-oxygen packages have also been updated with patch changes.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API Enhancements
themes.detail: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers, and new fields are available for cash management activities and drawers in POS. Additionally, the Customer object in Shopify Functions now includes a createdAt field.

themes.title: Ecosystem and App Updates
themes.detail: The shopify-account component is now a Theme Store requirement, and merchants can see partner details on collaborator requests. The Shopify CLI has been updated to version 4.6.0, removing deprecated features and adding new flags.
